title: Worked like a charm!
text:
Worked like a charm!. I frequently make cheesecakes and the occasional flourless cake, so I was looking forward to testing out the Kuhn Rikon PushPan. I followed the included instructions and used it to bake the chocolate almond torte from [[ASIN:1455617466 Scandinavian Classic Desserts (Classics)]]. As I was making it for a gluten-free / Passover audience, I used butter to grease the pan instead of my usual Baker's Joy (which contains flour). I made sure to press the bottom in securely; because there is a fair amount of resistance from the silicone gasket, you'll want to press down firmly on a level surface to make sure you have the bottom in all the way.

I wrapped heavy-duty foil around the base of the pan just in case, but no liquid seeped out through the silicone gasket (although I haven't tried it with a really wet batter yet). Once the cake had baked, I cooled it fully on a rack before removing the sides, which was a snap! I placed the pan on a can of peanuts (make sure that whatever item you use to remove the sides is a) taller than the PushPan and b) stable!), pushed down gently, and my chocolate torte sprang free without any of the batter stuck to the sides of the PushPan. Because I'd also used a buttered parchment round, the cake slid easily off the bottom. The nonstick used on the pan appears to be heavy-duty, and cleanup was a snap.

Some reviewers have mentioned that the 9" PushPan is smaller than a conventional springform pan, so you may want to take that into consideration if you're making a good-sized cheesecake.

Bottom line: easy cleanup and operation make the PushPan a winner, although I'm not sure about the longevity of the silicone gasket; it looks like something that may require replacement if you use it a lot. It is also available in 8" and 10" sizes.

product_metadata.title: Kuhn Rikon PushPan, 8-Inch
features: Silicone ring seals the pan so it never leaks
Nonstick coated for easy release of food and easy clean up
Easy to release finish product - no need to use a knife
Evenly cooks and browns your yummy creations
description: Kuhn Rikon's ingenious "no-spring" version of the springform pan makes it easy to create perfect quiches, tarts, cheesecakes, layer cakes and more. Traditional spring pans not only leak, they're fussy to use. Kuhn Rikon PushPan features a silicone ring to seal it shut so it never leaks. It's incredibly easy to release - no need to use a knife - just place it on a can or bowl and push down on sides. It evenly cooks and browns you yummy creations.
